why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the W.AI homepage Go to the W.AI homepage , where the app download and the network panel are found.
2 Step 2 : Download the W.AI app Use the download option on the homepage to install the W.AI app on the device you want to contribute.
3 Step 3 : Share idle compute Let the app use the device's idle compute power. The homepage says GPU compute cycles are what operators contribute to the network.
4 Step 4 : Earn W COIN rewards Keep contributing to the network. The homepage says this earns W COIN rewards, and it gives no amount or claim process.
